subject: Post-call recap: SLOs, streaming & customer-led load test plan
messages:
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@stellarus.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Subject: Post-call recap: SLOs, streaming & customer-led load test plan

Thanks again for the demo and the deep-dive, Daniel — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single plan to run the customer-led load test next week.

Recap of SLOs discussed (please confirm these are the targets you want us to validate):
- P50 generation latency (streaming start): <= 120ms
- P95 generation latency (end-to-end token completion): <= 400ms
- Sustained throughput target: 2,000 tokens/sec (approx ~60 concurrent streaming sessions with your prompt mix)
- Burst concurrency: up to 200 concurrent short sessions for 5 min windows
- Streaming: client expects chunked token streaming (EventStream) — must start streaming within 150ms of first token

Customer-led test specifics we discussed:
- Test window: June 17–18, 2026 (UTC-friendly window: 14:00–20:00 UTC both days)
- Scripts: we suggested a mix of k6-style steady traffic + Locust ramp for concurrency spikes (attached parameter file and a Redwood Locust worker stub)
- Test accounts: we need 3 non-prod API keys with rate-limit profiles (low/med/high) and a short-lived test user to validate auth flows
- IP allowlist: please provide IPs or ranges; we'll coordinate with infra to ensure connections from your test runners pass through our NAT/GW if needed

Attachments included: stellarus-loadtest-params.yaml (param sets), redwood-locust-worker.py (worker template), allowlist-ips.txt (placeholder)

Action items (owner in parens):
1) Daniel / Stellarus Ops: confirm test window and provide source IP list for allowlisting (Ops) — due EOD Fri 6/12
2) Stellarus: provide expected prompt distribution or sample prompt set (Ops) — due Mon 6/15
3) Redwood: create 3 test API keys and share prefixed tokens & scopes (Laura) — target Tue 6/16
4) Redwood infra (Dev): validate streaming throughput on a dedicated test pool and confirm concurrency headroom; confirm KV/prefix caching behavior under test (Dev) — due Wed 6/16
5) Both: run initial smoke test (10–15 min) day-before to validate metrics and observability hooks (all)

If the targets above look good, we'll lock scripts and run the smoke test on June 16 then full-run on June 17–18.

Thanks — attaching the param file now.

--
Sergio Alvarez

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SLOs, streaming & customer-led load test plan

Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Stellarus inputs below: 

1) Test window: June 17 14:00 UTC – June 18 20:00 UTC looks good. We prefer the heavy spike on day 1 (approx 18:00–18:10 UTC) and a steadier profile on day 2.
2) Prompt distribution: attaching a sample prompt set (short/medium/long). We'll upload the full set to the Drive link you shared by Monday.
3) IP allowlist: our test runners will come from the following egress IPs — please add to your allowlist: 34.82.11.45, 34.82.11.46, 34.82.11.47. We can also run via our partner's cloud if that helps with throughput testing; ping me if you want that option.
4) Test accounts: we only need non-prod keys with unlimited token quotas during the test window; we'll throttle on our side for realistic load. Please ensure the keys have the streaming scope enabled.

One ask: during the spike we want to verify graceful degradation and model-fallback behavior if the dedicated pool saturates — is there a simple rollback/fallback route you can trigger from the Console to switch to a lower-cost compatible model for the tail-end?

I'll confirm the full prompt set by Monday. Thanks — Daniel

--
Daniel Park

Subject: RE: Post-call recap: SLOs, streaming & customer-led load test plan

Looping internal infra/op for the technical confirmations. Dev — can you validate the following and reply with exact limits/commands we should run?
- Create three test API keys scoped for streaming and token generation; label them stellarus-test-low/med/high. Check that these keys are exempt from billing/quotas for the test window.
- Confirm concurrency headroom on the dedicated pool: can we sustain 60 steady streaming sessions and handle 200 concurrent short sessions for spikes? If not, list recommended pool size (GPU count / instance type).
- Confirm whether prefix/KV cache is warmable via our smoke script; if not, provide a short pre-warm command we can run with the provided param set.
- Provide a Console link or script to trigger the fallback to a compatible model variant for graceful degradation during the spike (Daniel asked for manual fallback).

I've attached a short markdown note describing how to provision the test accounts (test-account-instructions.md). Sergio — once Dev confirms, I'll hand over tokens to Daniel and schedule the smoke run on June 16.

Thanks — Laura

Thanks all — quick consolidated update after internal checks.

Dev status (Dev Patel):
- Test API keys: will be created and handed off by Tue 2026-06-16 17:00 UTC (stellarus-test-low/med/high) — they will be scoped for streaming and marked non-billing for the window.
- Concurrency: dedicated pool confirmed to handle 60 steady streaming sessions + 200 short concurrent sessions for 5-minute bursts using the recommended 4xA10g worker pool. If Stellarus needs higher sustained throughput, we'll provision an extra 2 GPUs for the spike (advise by EOD Mon).
- Pre-warm: provide a pre-warm script (one-off single-threaded run) that hits the prefix set and warms KV cache; will attach command to the drive folder.
- Fallback: Console toggle exists to switch routing to a compatible lower-resource model variant (manual operation); Dev will document the Console path and the API call for automated switching.

Stellarus inputs received: prompt sample (partial) + allowlist IPs (34.82.11.45-47). Daniel, we'll add these to the firewall allowlist and share confirmation when done.

Next milestones:
- Mon 6/15: Stellarus uploads full prompt set to Drive (Daniel)
- Tue 6/16 17:00 UTC: Redwood hands over test API keys (Laura)
- Tue 6/16 18:00 UTC: brief smoke test (15 min) to validate connectivity, streaming start times, and metric collection (all)
- Wed 6/17 14:00 UTC: full run begins (heavy spike on day 1 evening window)

Attaching the final param file and the Locust worker template in Drive. If any of the SLO numbers above need adjustment before the smoke test, flag them now. Otherwise I'll mark the plan confirmed and set calendar invites.
